## Horizon3.ai - Senior Backend Engineer – Growth, MSSP

🔗 [Apply](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/horizon3ai/e3a763c3-2e2c-4428-a68e-26c98e7410d4)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Senior Backend Engineer building licensing, provisioning, access, and MSSP infrastructure for Horizon3’s NodeZero autonomous cybersecurity platform. Operating reliable multi-tenant backend services in production.
Senior Backend Engineer building NodeZero’s multi-tenant cybersecurity platform at Horizon3
- Salary: $170,000 - $235,000 per year
- Tech stack: AWS, Azure, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Java, Kubernetes, Postgres, Python, Scala, SQL, TypeScript, C++, Go
- Design and implement backend services enforcing licensing, entitlements, feature access, usage limits, and packaging rules
- Build and evolve provisioning and onboarding workflows for account setup, entitlement propagation, and auto-provisioning
- Develop infrastructure for user access controls, account settings, parent-child account relationships, RBAC, and authorization
- Build MSP/MSSP capabilities including asset allocation, sub-client management, usage visibility, and reporting workflows
- Implement audit logging and event history systems for administrative, entitlement, usage, and account-level actions
- Develop the notifications platform for usage warnings, consumption alerts, overage notices, product announcements, and other communications
- Operate services in production, contributing to monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and support workflows
- Contribute production code meeting standards for design quality, test coverage, observability, and operational rigor
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience using modern object-oriented or functional languages such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, Scala, or C++
- Experience building production applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP
- Experience using Docker and Kubernetes
- Ability to own and manage concurrent initiatives
- Strong prioritization and time management
- Self-directed and able to implement solutions independently and as part of a team
- Strong desire to continuously learn new technologies in a fast-paced Agile environment

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Senior Backend Engineer building licensing, provisioning, access, and MSSP infrastructure for Horizon3’s NodeZero autonomous cybersecurity platform. Operating reliable multi-tenant backend services in production.
Senior Backend Engineer building NodeZero’s multi-tenant cybersecurity platform at Horizon3
Role description:
• Design and implement backend services enforcing licensing, entitlements, feature access, usage limits, and packaging rules
• Build and evolve provisioning and onboarding workflows for account setup, entitlement propagation, and auto-provisioning
• Develop infrastructure for user access controls, account settings, parent-child account relationships, RBAC, and authorization
• Build MSP/MSSP capabilities including asset allocation, sub-client management, usage visibility, and reporting workflows
• Implement audit logging and event history systems for administrative, entitlement, usage, and account-level actions
• Develop the notifications platform for usage warnings, consumption alerts, overage notices, product announcements, and other communications
• Operate services in production, contributing to monitoring, runbooks, incident response, and support workflows
• Contribute production code meeting standards for design quality, test coverage, observability, and operational rigor
• Collaborate with Pentest Data Platform and Platform Integration Team to apply entitlement, access, and account-hierarchy rules consistently
• Lead through technical judgment, system design, and reliable execution as a senior individual contributor
• Own significant pieces of platform infrastructure while balancing feature delivery, long-term platform investment, and production health
Role requirements:
• Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field
• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience using modern object-oriented or functional languages such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, Scala, or C++
• Experience building production applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Experience using Docker and Kubernetes
• Ability to own and manage concurrent initiatives
• Strong prioritization and time management
• Self-directed and able to implement solutions independently and as part of a team
• Strong desire to continuously learn new technologies in a fast-paced Agile environment
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
• High attention to detail and quality
• Strong technical documentation ability, including design docs, runbooks, and support documentation
• Effective communication and collaboration across engineering, product, and design
• Interest in mentoring junior and mid-level engineers
• Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and tenant isolation
• Experience with RBAC, authorization, authentication, or SSO systems
• Experience with licensing, subscription, entitlement, usage metering, or billing-adjacent systems
• Experience designing audit log or event history systems
• Familiarity with provisioning, feature flags, and staged rollout patterns
• Experience building admin consoles or customer self-service workflows
• Experience with MSP, MSSP, or multi-tenant partner models
• Experience with notifications infrastructure
• Production reliability experience, including observability tooling, on-call ownership, runbook authorship, and incident response
• Expert proficiency in SQL
• Experience with relational database architectures, particularly PostgreSQL
• Comfort with complex data models involving account hierarchies, usage records, and entitlement state

• Equity package in the form of stock options for all full-time roles

• Vision insurance for you and your family
• Dental insurance for you and your family
• Flexible vacation policy
• Generous parental leave
• Career development opportunities
• Inclusive culture
• Collaborative and innovative work environment
• Remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location
Tech stack:
AWS, Azure, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Java, Kubernetes, Postgres, Python, Scala, SQL, TypeScript, C++, Go
